services.value: DFW Environmental Laboratories provides professional water, soil, and air analytical services. Services include organics testing (e.g., hydrocarbon testing for TPH/BTEX, VOC & SVOC, PAH & PCBs, pesticides, alcohols/glycols, odorants, and methane/ethane/ethene/propane) and inorganics testing (e.g., RCRA/lead/copper/minerals, COD/BOD, hexavalent chromium, anions, nitrogen, total organic carbon, dissolved/suspended solids, flash point/viscosity/density, and color/odor analysis).
